# telnyx_whatsapp_business_account_delete (Action)

Disconnects a WhatsApp Business Account (WABA) from your Telnyx account. This cannot be undone: the account has to be connected again through the WhatsApp signup flow.



<!-- action schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `whatsapp_business_account_id` (String) The whatsapp business account id.
